name: singlet_trajectory_pseudotime_ordering
title: Pseudotime ordering along a lineage
description: Orders cells along one lineage by a scalar pseudotime oriented from a required root cell. Default method dpt (diffusion pseudotime) on obsm/X_pca; palantir adds fixed-point refinement; slingshot returns per-lineage arc length. Writes obs/pseudotime_<method> and an orientation record. Does not infer topology, fate probabilities or calibrated time; do not use without a correct root.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

root.description: Root cell id, or the name of a boolean obs column marking start cells. Sets origin and sign; required.

method.description: Ordering method. Use dpt unless lineage-specific values (slingshot) or refinement (palantir) are needed.

representation.description: Embedding used for distances and curve fitting, with one row per cell.

orientation_markers.description: Gene to expected sign with progression (+1 rising, -1 falling). Used only for the orientation record.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Waypoint sampling seed for palantir; dpt and slingshot are deterministic.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

n_dcs.description: Number of diffusion components used in the distance.

n_neighbors.description: kNN size for the graph when obsp/connectivities is absent.

knn.description: kNN size for the geodesic graph.

num_waypoints.description: Number of waypoints from max-min sampling.

cluster_key.description: obs column of cluster labels that defines the lineage scaffold.

start_cluster.description: Start cluster for orientation; null uses the cluster containing the root.

approx_points.description: Points approximating each curve; null gives 150 when n exceeds 150.

stretch.description: Factor by which curves may extend beyond endpoint clusters.

thresh.description: Convergence threshold on percent change in projection distance.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/pseudotime_dpt. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, root_cell, n_cells, n_unreachable, n_lineages, orientation_rho.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
